searchText: Will EIP4844 lower maxFeePerGas and not the gas Limit of a transaction on Layer 2?? I am trying to understand how it will affect layer 2 transaction cost anyone knows if possible to sync a new node from genesis after Dencun? yes, theres nothing new in the Dencun fork that would prevent this. Usual caveats about weak subjectivity period, but still nothing new in Dencun, sure.
